text:
viv: Quick heads-up — bringing Kite v0.3-int4 to staging. Locale-mix test showed odd quote / bidi behavior when CJK precedes Hebrew. sacreBLEU -3.2 vs fp32.
joel: can you paste the mini repro?
sana: minimal payload I used: { src: "他說: אבג \"test\"", lang: "zh-he_mixed" }
viv: staging output (raw): "他說: ‏אבג ＂test＂" — note RLM and fullwidth quotes. FP32 was clean: "他說: אבג \"test\""
joel: token dumps?
sana: int4 token dump: TOKS=["他說", ":", "‏", "א", "ב", "ג", "＂", "test", "＂"]
FP32 TOKS=["他說", ":", "א", "ב", "ג", """, "test", """]
joel: looks like a BOM or marker got injected during qpack. check qpack.py write flags.
viv: I also saw our fast east-asian-normalize step convert ASCII quotes to fullwidth when it shouldn't.
l10n-bot: queued bisect job: eng-ml/kite-int4/onboard-bisect -> suspect qpack env + runtime-normalize.
ci-bot: patch branch created: fix/kite-int4-bom-guard by joel. CI smoke will run.
joel: plan: (1) disable BOM write in qpack for quant builds, (2) add is_cjk(prev) guard around east-asian-normalize, (3) add unit for mixed zh+he+ascii quotes to locale-mix-suite.
sana: after local patch BLEU delta is -0.1. will monitor nightly.
viv: thanks—please leave thread open until nightly green. will add a short note to model-onboard checklist about qpack BOM pitfalls.
ci-bot: nightly locale-mix run enqueued.
